ξανθοσ.g: -ή, -όν. Yellow. Of horses, bay or chestnut Il. 9.407, Il. 11.680. Of hair, yellow, fair Il. 1.197, Il. 23.141 : Od. 13.399, 431. As a personal epithet, of the fair hair, fair-haired. Of Meleager Il. 2.642. Of Menelaus Il. 3.284, 434, Il. 4.183, 210, etc. : Od. 1.285, Od. 3.168, 257, 326, etc. So κάρη ξανθὸς Μενέλαος Od. 15.133. Of Demeter Il. 5.500. Of Agamede Il. 11.740. Of Rhadamanthus Od. 4.564, Od. 7.323.

ξεινηιοσ.g: [ξεῖνος.] 1 Such as may fitly be given by a host to a guest : δῶρα Od. 24.273. 2 Absol. in neut., a present given by a host to a guest, or given one to the other by persons between whom the ξεῖνος relationship exists (see ξεῖνος 2) : ἀλλήλοισι πόρον ξεινήϊα Il. 6.218. Cf. Il. 10.269, Il. 11.20 : Od. 8.389, Od. 9.267. Sarcastically : τοῦτό (i.e. the stroke with the spear) τοι ἀντὶ ποδὸς ξεινήϊον [ἔσται] Od. 22.290. Cf. Od. 9.370. 3 Absol. in neut. pl., fare or good things put before a guest : παράθες οἱ ξεινήϊα Il. 18.408. Cf. Od. 3.490, Od. 4.33.

ξεινιζω.g: [ξεῖνος.] 1 pl. fut. ξεινίσσομεν Od. 7.190. Aor. ἐξείνισσα Il. 3.207 : Od. 19.194, Od. 24.266, 271. 2 sing. ξείνισας Od. 19.217. ξείνισσας Od. 24.288. 3 sing. ξείνισε Il. 6.217. ξείνισσε Il. 3.232, Il. 6.174. Infin. ξεινίσαι Od. 14.322. To receive or entertain hospitably, treat as an honoured guest Il. 3.207, 232, Il. 6.174, 217 : Od. 3.355, Od. 7.190, Od. 14.322, Od. 19.194 = Od. 24.271, Od. 19.217, Od. 24.266, 288.

ξεινιοσ.g: [ξεῖνος.] 1 That guards the obligations arising from the relationship of guest and host and the claim of strangers to protection. Epithet of Zeus Il. 13.625 : Od. 9.271, Od. 14.284. 2 Absol. in neut., a present given by a host to a guest Od. 9.229, 365, Od. 19.185. Sarcastically Od. 9.356, Od. 20.296. 3 Absol. in neut. pl., fare or good things put before a guest Il. 11.779, Il. 18.387 := Od. 5.91, Od. 14.404, Od. 15.188. Sarcastically Od. 9.517.

ξεινοδοκοσ.g: -ου, ὁ [ξεῖνος + δοκ-, δέχομαι.] A host, one's host Il. 3.354 : Od. 8.210, 543, Od. 15.55, 70, Od. 18.64.

ξεινοσ.g: -ου, ὁ. 1 A foreigner or stranger. a A foreigner, one belonging to another land : ἐπʼ ἀνθρώους ξείνους ἠδʼ οἷσιν ἀνάσσεις Il. 24.202. One not of one's own immediate folk : ξεῖνοί τε καὶ αὐτοῦ βώτορες Od. 14.102. Cf. Od. 17.382. b A stranger, one who comes into, or finds himself in, a land not his own : εἰσῆλθε μυκήνας ξ. Il. 4.377. Cf. Il. 4.387 : Od. 7.24, Od. 18.106 (wanderers or vagabonds), Od. 19.333 (travellers), Od. 21.292. Such a person regarded as being under the guardianship of Zeus, as entitled to protection and aid : πρὸς διός εἰσι ξεῖνοί τε πτωχοί τε Od. 6.208= Od. 14.58. Cf. Od. 8.546, Od. 9.270, 478, Od. 14.57, Od. 16.108, Od. 18.222, etc. c A stranger, a person whom one has not seen before, an unknown person who presents himself before one : πόθεν τοι ξ. ὅδʼ ἵκετο; Od. 16.57. Cf. Od. 1.120, Od. 4.26, Od. 6.209, Od. 8.28, Od. 14.414, Od. 17.10, Od. 18.401, Od. 20.129, etc. Vocativally Od. 1.123, Od. 3.71, Od. 4.371, Od. 6.187, etc. Vocativally by a ξ. to one of those among whom he has come Od. 8.166, Od. 14.53. 2 One of two persons (in pl. the persons) dwelling at a distance from each other between whom there exists a special tie of friendship and mutual hospitality : ξ. μοι πατρώϊός ἐσσι Il. 6.215. Cf. Il. 6.224, 231, Il. 13.661, Il. 15.532, Il. 17.150, 584, Il. 21.42 : ξ. ἐμός ἐστιν Od. 11.338. Cf. Od. 1.105, 176, 187, 313, Od. 9.18, Od. 15.196, Od. 19.191, Od. 24.104, etc. 3 A host, one's host : ξείνια παρέθηκεν, ἅ τε ξείνοις θέμις ἐστίν Il. 11.779. Cf. Od. 8.208, Od. 9.268, Od. 19.371. 4 A guest, one's guest : ξεινοδόκοι καὶ ξ. Od. 8.543. Cf. Od. 3.350, Od. 15.54, 73, 74, Od. 20.295= Od. 21.313, Od. 21.27.

ξεινοσυνη.g: -ης, ἡ [ξεῖνος.] The ξεῖνος relationship (see ξεῖνος 2) Od. 21.35.

ξενιη.g: -ης, ἡ [ξεν-, ξεῖνος.] Hospitable bounty : μίξεσθαι ξενίῃ (in mutual hospitality) Od. 24.314. Cf. Od. 24.286.

ξενιοσ.g: -η, -ον [ = ξείνιος.] 1 That serves as a symbol of the obligations of a guest in reference to his host or of the claims of a stranger to protection : ἴστω ξενίη τράπεζα Od. 14.158= Od. 17.155= Od. 20.230. 2 = ξείνιος 1 Od. 14.389. 3 Absol. in neut. pl. = ξείνοις3 Od. 15.514, 546.

ξεροσ.g: Dry. Absol. in neut., the dry land, the shore : ποτὶ ξερὸν ἠπείροιο Od. 5.402.

ξεστοσ.g: -ή, -όν [ξεσ-, ξέω.] Smoothed, smooth, wrought, polished : αἰθούσῃσιν (of wrought stone) Il. 6.243, Il. 20.11, λίθοιο Il. 6.244, 248. Cf. Il. 18.504 : Od. 1.138= Od. 4.54= Od. 7.174= Od. 10.370 = Od. 15.137= Od. 17.93, Od. 3.406, Od. 8.6, Od. 10.211 = 253, Od. 12.172, Od. 14.350, Od. 16.408, Od. 18.33, Od. 19.566, Od. 22.72. Of the Trojan horse : ἵππῳ ἔνι ξεστῷ Od. 4.272.

ξεω.g: 3 sing. aor. ἔξεσε Il. 5.81. ξέσσε Od. 5.245, Od. 17.341, Od. 21.44. (ἀμφι-) 1 To remove roughness or irregularities from the surface of, smooth, work up Od. 5.245, Od. 17.341 = Od. 21.44, Od. 23.199. 2 With ἀπό, to slice off : ἀπὸ δʼ ἔξεσε χεῖρα Il. 5.81.

ξυλον.g: -ου, τό. 1 A piece of wood, a post Il. 23.327. 2 In pl., wood for burning, firewood : ξύλα πολλὰ λέγεσθε Il. 8.507. Cf. Il. 8.547, Il. 18.347, Il. 21.364, Il. 24.778 : Od. 3.429, Od. 8.436, Od. 14.418, Od. 15.322, etc.

ξυλοχοσ.g: -ου, ἡ [ξύλον.] A wood, coppice, thicket Il. 5.162, Il. 11.415, Il. 21.573 : Od. 4.335= Od. 17.126, Od. 19.445.

ξυν.g: See σύν. ξυμ-, ξυν-. See συμ-, συν-.

ξυνηιοσ.g: [ξυνός.] In common : τεύχεʼ ἀμφότεροι ξυνήϊα ταῦτα φερέσθων Il. 23.809. Absol. in neut. pl. ξυνήϊα, a common store : οὔ τί που ἴδμεν ξυνήϊα κείμενα πολλά (laid up in abundance) Il. 1.124.

ξυνοσ.g: -ή, -όν. Common : γαῖʼ ἔτι ξυνή [ἐστιν] Il. 15.193. Cf. Il. 16.262. Impartial Il. 18.309.

ξυρον.g: -οῦ, τό. A razor. Fig. : ἐπὶ ξυροῦ ἵσταται ἀκμῆς ἢ . . . ἠὲ . . . Il. 10.173.

ξυστον.g: -οῦ, τό [neut. of ξυστός, vbl. adj. from ξύω. That which is worked smooth.] 1 A spear Il. 4.469= Il. 11.260, Il. 11.565, Il. 13.497. 2 Some kind of long pole used in sea-fighting Il. 15.388, 677.

ξυω.g: (ἀπο-) To remove irregularities from the surface of, scrape smooth : λίστροισιν δάπεδον ξῦον Od. 22.456. To treat so as to produce a smooth surface upon : ἑανόν, ὅν οἱ Ἀθήνη ἔξυσʼ ἀσκησασα Il. 14.179.
